subject: secr4.3.1 mark-resight model fit with sessioncov "Error: Can't use character names to index an unnamed vector""

messages.author: affeb158edb3f91c
messages.subject: secr4.3.1 mark-resight model fit with sessioncov "Error: Can't use character names to index an unnamed vector""
parts:
Hello secr users,

I am fitting a secr model using multi-session (20 sessions/25 occasions/98 traps) animal sighting-only data (proximity detector), which includes Tm and Tu sightings, using the falling function call:

mod = secr.fit(CH, model = list(D~session,g0~season),mask = mask, detectfn = 0, details = list(knownmarks=TRUE),sessioncov = sess.cov.df)

where 'season' is a factor (but I have also tried as character/numeric) in the sess.cov.df dataframe.

The model fits OK. But when I use summary() or predict(), an error is raised:

"Error: Can't use character names to index an unnamed vector."

This error only occurs when including the session covariate. 

R version 4.0.2/secr 4.3.1. 

Any suggestions are much appreciated.

Thanks

Roland

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: secr4.3.1 mark-resight model fit with sessioncov "Error: Can't use character names to index an unnamed vector""
parts:
Possibly something odd is happening in secr.make.newdata(). Do you get the same error with 
secr.make.newdata(mod)?

Is sessioncov a dataframe? If not you could try replacing it with mod$sessioncov <- data.frame(mod$sessioncov) or similar.
